faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XE P250 use?
faqLeft.a: The XE P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200, a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It's the mid-range petrol option in the current-era XE lineup.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XE P250 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XE P250?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code (AJ200) before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ200 XE P250 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn timing chain components, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every AJ200 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XE P250 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XE P250 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XE P250 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XE P250 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
